edges.reason: Constructor assigns the owner state variable directly from msg.sender.
Constructor writes the deployer address into owner.
Constructor initializes registrationFee to 0.069 ether.
register keys all subscription state reads and writes on msg.sender.
expirationDate is derived from block.timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency for subscription validity.
userPastExpiration decides entitlement by comparing block.timestamp with stored expirationDate.
registrationFee is read in the msg.value requirement of register.
register pushes the caller address onto addressList.
register writes isPaid and expirationDate into the UserRegistion mapping.
userPastExpiration reads expirationDate from the UserRegistion mapping.
resetUserPaidStatus invokes userPastExpiration for each supplied address.
resetUserPaidStatus clears the isPaid flag in the UserRegistion mapping.
setNewOwner overwrites the owner state variable with the supplied address.
setNewRegistrationPrice overwrites the registrationFee state variable.
withdrawToOwner reaches the state-changing external transfer of the contract balance.
withdrawToAddress reaches the external transfer to an arbitrary recipient.
The withdrawn balance is sent to the owner address.
giveAccountAway sets isPaid to true in the UserRegistion mapping without payment.
External value transfer to a caller-supplied address could invoke recipient code, but transfer forwards only 2300 gas so reentrancy is not practically exploitable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing owner mutation.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing fee mutation.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing batch status reset.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing balance withdrawal.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing arbitrary withdrawal.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing free grants.
Parameter _address is used to index the UserRegistion mapping inside userPastExpiration.
Parameter _newOwner flows into the owner state variable assignment.
Parameter _newFee flows into the registrationFee state variable assignment.
Parameter array _address drives the reset loop that mutates UserRegistion.
Parameter _recipient becomes the target of the external value transfer.
Parameter _amount becomes the value of the external transfer.
Parameter _address selects the mapping entry whose isPaid flag is granted for free.
Local loop counter i controls iteration bounds in resetUserPaidStatus.
